decisions.reason: The required GPIO5, GPIO38, and GPIO26 reassignments are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Selecting the WROOM-1 module and reassigning the identified GPIOs do not change the standalone USB 3.3V supply behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY changes enable_gpio to GPIO5 but leaves the LED standby policy's obsolete GPIO3 reference unchanged.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Sorry, GPIO3 was from my original ESP32 design — mistake on my side. For 5V_EN you can use GPIO5. Also I realized GPIO22, 23, 25, 27 are not exposed on the WROOM-1 module, so I need to reassign SCL0 (GPIO22→38), SPI MOSI (GPIO23→26). I'll update the docs and send you the full updated GPIO table.

value_updates.led_standby_power_policy: Switch off the entire 5V rail through 5V_EN controlled by GPIO5 when the LEDs are not needed, reducing their standby current to zero

decisions.reason: The module variant and GPIO reassignments do not alter the DCDC1 rail voltage, rating, or normal-operation role.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already updates its 5V_EN standby control from GPIO3 to GPIO5; its GPIO13 data assignment is unaffected.
The source decision does not change the sensor board's role as a connector fanout.
The WROOM-1 selection and GPIO changes do not alter the AXP2101 battery or system power path.
The source does not change the USB data lines, their interboard route, or standalone programming behavior.
The controller module and GPIO assignments do not change the battery electrical-protection requirements.
The source decision does not affect the J_BAT NTC connection or AXP2101 thermal-protection role.
The charge-status GPIO13 and dedicated CHGLED interface are not changed by the specified WROOM-1 GPIO compatibility corrections.
SCL0 and 5V_EN remain the same connector signals; changing their controller-side GPIO assignments does not alter the interboard connector pinout.
